Maria (CS): Quick heads-up — Aurius renewal signing runbook needs finalization. SOW signed acceptance by 2026-05-12, we need signer + payment path confirmed. cc @Sam (AM) @Raj (Legal)
Sam (AM): On it. Customer prefers ACH but asked for net30. Need to know if Finance can accept net30 + wiring fallback.
Raj (Legal): I reviewed the latest redline. Mostly ok except payment terms in 4.2 — we flagged delegated-signature threshold. Do we have approval to allow delegate up to $250k?
Kate (Finance): We can accept net30 for Aurius US entity if billing entity matches TaxID on file. Wiring fallback OK but fees are on customer unless we include surcharge. Need final billing entity and wire details before sending envelope.
Oliver (Ops): For the runbook: who will create the DocuSign envelope and set signer order? I can create the envelope and lock fields once we confirm signer identity.
Maria (CS): Proposed flow: 1) Verify signer identity & billing entity 2) Finance confirms wiring details 3) Legal confirms redline acceptance + delegate threshold 4) Ops creates envelope with signer order and sends.
Sam (AM): I can confirm signer today — primary signer is Miranda (VP Finance). Miranda might delegate to their Director (authorized). I'll confirm whether Miranda will sign or delegate.
Raj (Legal): If Miranda delegates, we need an explicit delegating clause added to the envelope and a delegated-signer attestation. I can add a one-line addendum instead of a full redline. OK with $250k threshold.
Maria (CS): Copy. Once Sam confirms, please post exact name + email. Also need final billing entity name (US or EU) so Kate can match taxid.
Kate (Finance): Aurius US (TaxID: 12-3456789). Wire instructions we have on file: Bank: First Harbor, Acct ****4321, Routing 111000025. If they want card fallback, we need to add 2.9% handling.
Oliver (Ops): I'll plan to run these commands to create the envelope once details come in:
```
docusign create-envelope --template SOW-2026 --signer-order 1,2 --require-id-verify true --add-attestation "delegated-signer"
```
Will set signer 1 = Miranda (or delegate) and signer 2 = Legal countersign.
Sam (AM): Miranda confirmed: she will delegate to Derek (Director) — Derek's email derek@aurius.com. Miranda will email a short delegation note to Derek and cc us.
Maria (CS): Great. Raj — is the short delegation note sufficient for legal?
Raj (Legal): Yes, add the wording in the envelope: "Signer authorized by Miranda (VP Finance) via internal delegation email dated <date>". Keep the email in the envelope attachments.
Kate (Finance): Once envelope sent, please tag me. I'll prepare invoice against Aurius US and release wire instructions to their AP only after envelope completes.
Oliver (Ops): Created draft envelope in staging. Will swap to prod after Maria confirms. Need final signer name/email + final billing entity string to replace placeholders.
Maria (CS): Updating CS tracker now: https://redwood.internal/cs/tracker/aurius-renewal (I added delegation step).
Sam (AM): I'll update customer and aim to have delegation email by 18:00 PT.
signing-bot: Reminder scheduled: sending envelope at 2026-05-10T16:00:00Z unless we request hold. Use /hold-envelope to pause. :bell:
